title: Black-clad protesters in balaclavas block road at port of Dover in Kent
summary_full: Traffic on A20 in and out of port grinds to halt as Kent police say they are in attendance and engaging with groupDozens of people dressed in black and wearing balaclavas blocked the road at the port of Dover in Kent, forcing closures in both directions on Saturday morning.Kent police said they were were in attendance and engaging with the protest, which the Port of Dover described as a “public order incident”. Responsibility for the demonstration appears to have been claimed by an anti-immigration group with links to the far right. Continue reading...
